description: Check WCAG contrast between a foreground and background color. Operations: "check" — Compute the contrast ratio and WCAG pass/fail for a color pair.; "best-text" — Pick black or white text for the best contrast on a background.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: check: The foreground color (#rrggbb, #rgb or rgb(...)). best-text: The background color.

operation.description: check — Compute the contrast ratio and WCAG pass/fail for a color pair. best-text — Pick black or white text for the best contrast on a background.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

background.description: The background color. Used by: check. Required by: check.

name: contrast
title: Color Contrast Checker
